messages:
sre-oncall: Holding today's 09:00 UTC release slot. We are seeing a cross-region KV cache inconsistency affecting EU edge (incid#: 64321). Aborting canary rollout for now. :rotating_light:
deploy-bot: Release slot 2026-03-21T09:00 UTC held by sre-oncall — canary aborted, jobs cancelled. Notifying owners.
eng-release: Thanks — any ETA on root cause?
kevin: Observed a ~30s divergence in prefix TTLs between eu-west and eu-central caches, causing stale reads. Tracing now.
maria: If reads can return stale embeddings it could break rerank logic. We should pin the previous model/hash for traffic until resolved.
product-ops: Agreed — we should also pause the release notes publish for this patch and hold the customer-facing comms until we confirm.
ops-lead: For rollout strategy: propose we revert to pinned v2026-03-19-2 in the EU zones, then validate, then gradually requeue the canary after cache fix. Thoughts?
alice: Revert sounds safest. Small hotfix is riskier unless we can guarantee cache invalidation.
kevin: I can roll a configuration rollback: kubectl -n orbit rollout undo deploy/edge-inference --to-revision=42, then trigger cache flush job: 
```
kubectl -n orbit exec -it cache-flusher -- /bin/sh -c "./flush-prefixes --regions=eu-*"
```
pm-anna: Who will own the rollback? Need a short checklist for releasebot so we can unhold/reschedule automatically.
sre-oncall: Kevin take the rollback, ops-lead coordinate smoke tests. I'll keep the incident channel open and update status.
eng-release: Deploy-bot, after rollback, please do not auto-resume any queued releases — require manual approval from sre-oncall.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Requeue disabled until manual /approve-resume.
product-ops: Timeline proposal: rollback now, 30m smoke, if green requeue a staggered rollout at +2 hours with per-zone gating. If not green, reschedule to tomorrow morning slot and escalate.
kevin: Started rollback now. ETA 10m for rollout-undo.
sre-oncall: Thanks. Also add to release notes draft: "Release delayed due to cache divergence in EU edge; rescheduling pending validation." We will add full technical summary after RCA.
alice: Adding a short ops note to release doc and slack #customers-notify draft.
eng-release: Confirming: do not merge release notes or run notify-workflow until I mark it "safe".
product-ops: I'll hold the scheduled blog/email. pm-anna will update stakeholders.
pm-anna: Noted — I'll ping legal/comms once we have validation pass.
sre-oncall: Update at +15m or sooner if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
